column2: tp53_genotype_literature.tsv -- HAND-CURATED TP53 genotype from source publications.
One row per sample (or per patient, repeated across that patient's samples).
tp53_status   : mutant | wildtype | uninformative   (uninformative = TP53 not assayed / not reported)
evidence_tier : A_genotype  = per-cell or per-sample sequencing call reported by the authors
B_reported  = mutation listed in a paper table without per-cell resolution
C_karyotype = cytogenetics only (del(17p)/complex) -- NOT a genotype, kept for cross-checks
Every row MUST carry a citation. Rows are added only from a primary source that names the variant
or explicitly states TP53 wild-type; "not mentioned" is NOT wildtype and must stay out of this file.
